title: Concept: Dependency fetched from a plain URL
description: package.json declares a plain HTTPS artifact URL instead of a registry specifier, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a plain HTTPS artifact URL instead of a registry specifier.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a plain HTTPS artifact URL instead of a registry specifier.
